title: Extension of a generic-fibre torsor action to a given finite etale cover
statement: Let $S$ be an integral normal scheme, and $c:C\to S$ a smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $K$ be the function field of $S$, let $i:\operatorname{Spec}K\to S$ be the generic-point morphism, and let $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}K$, $j:C_\eta\to C$ give a cartesian square with $i,c$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $G$ be any finite group, $Z\to C_\eta$ a finite etale $G$-torsor, and $\pi:P\to C$ any finite etale morphism. Suppose $\psi:Z\to P$ makes the square with sides $Z\to C_\eta,\pi$ and bottom $j$ cartesian. Then there exist morphisms $a_g:P\to P$ over $C$ for every $g\in G$, with $a_1=1$, $a_{gh}=a_h;a_g$ in diagrammatic composition, and $g_Z;\psi=\psi;a_g$, such that $\coprod_{g\in G}P\to P\times_C P$, whose component is $(a_g,1)$, is an isomorphism. There is no assumption of an invertible group order, a section of $c$, or connectedness of $Z$ or $P$.

source.place: Tag 0BQM; Tag 0EYJ, proof: extension of the group action to the finite cover, and the torsor identity

proof.text: Extend each Z.smul(g) uniquely by finiteEtale_genericFibre_hom_extension and choose the resulting maps a_g. The extension property gives a_g;π=π and Z.smul(g);ψ=ψ;a_g.

Apply uniqueness of the extension of Z.smul(1) to id_P to obtain a_1=id_P. Apply uniqueness for Z.smul(gh) to a_h;a_g. Its over-C property follows from those of a_h and a_g; its restriction equals Z.smul(h);Z.smul(g)=Z.smul(gh) using the two compatibility equations and associativity.
Apply isIso_sigmaDesc_of_genericFibre to the compatible family a. It shows directly that the canonical map coproduct_g P → P ×_C P is an isomorphism, completing the conjunction.

proof_origin.note: Formalized action-law assembly and torsor inverse extension. Only generic-fibre full faithfulness remains as a named theorem.

lean.statement: theorem GaloisCover.exists_action_on_finiteEtale_extension {S C : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral S] (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x)) (c : C ⟶ S) [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c] (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C) (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c) (Z : GaloisCover G Cη) {P : Scheme.{u}} (π : P ⟶ C) [IsFinite π] [Etale π] (ψ : Z.P ⟶ P) (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π π j) : ∃ (a : G → (P ⟶ P)) (ha : ∀ g : G, a g ≫ π = π), a 1 = 𝟙 P ∧ (∀ g h : G, a (g * h) = a h ≫ a g) ∧ (∀ g : G, Z.smul g ≫ ψ = ψ ≫ a g) ∧ IsIso (Sigma.desc fun g : G ↦ pullback.lift (f := π) (g := π) (a g) (𝟙 P) (by simp [ha]))
